meta.notes: A trade set picks amount trades from trades, a villager trade tag (#namespace:path) or a list of trade ids; allow_duplicates false never picks one twice. Vanilla villagers use the sets named after their profession and level, such as minecraft:fletcher/level_1, and the wandering trader uses minecraft:wandering_trader/common. A project set with one of those names replaces vanilla's, which is the way to guarantee a trade. This one has a name of its own, so no villager uses it yet: named minecraft:fletcher/level_1, it would make every novice fletcher offer three of the tag's trades.
